entities.name: linter
entities.how_described: 本集说 linter 是以确定性方式把代码库规则编码化的工具；AI 时代写新 linter 变得很便宜，可以直接让智能体来写，用它替代反复提示。

evidence.quote: Writing an actual linter took a lot of work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If it's pre-agents, and those are humans that are working in my code base, and the only thing I'm doing is once every three weeks telling people to use the right component from the design system, then I don't necessarily need a linter for that, right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And at the same time, to write a new linter is very cheap and very easy.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So the first linter we created was a linter that says if there is a code block
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: One example is Taskless, where instead of writing the actual linter, you write what you want the linter to do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You write your intent in English language, and then the actual linter is derived from it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
